info.name: App Marketplace accounting-entries Export Items (v2) API

params.name: job_id
params.description: The Export Job ID in which the accounting entries have been included for export.

params.name: before
params.description: Lower bound of the page of data to return (cannot be used together with [after] or [offset]).

params.name: after
params.description: Upper bound of the page of data to return (cannot be used together with [before] or [offset]).

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset of the page of data to return (cannot be used together with [before] or [after]).

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum amount of items to return.

params.name: sorting_keys
params.description: The keys to sort the results by.

params.name: sorting_order
params.description: The order to sort the results by. Must be the same length as [sortingKeys]; one order per key.

items.docs:
An export item = an accounting entry that has been transformed into an exportable entry.
The required accounting and bookkeeping information is aggregated from an accounting entry to become an export item. Use this endpoint to retrieve a list of export items that have been selected for export. Please note that you can retrieve list of export items only from `pending` and `in_progress` export jobs.
